> [comment]: # (Please do your best to search for duplicate issues before filing a new issue so we can keep our issue board clean)
> [comment]: # (Every issue should have exactly one feature request described in it. Please do not file feedback list tickets as it is difficult to parse them and address their individual points)
> [comment]: # (Feature Requests are better when they’re open-ended instead of demanding a specific solution e.g: “I want an easier way to do X” instead of “add Y”)
> [comment]: # (Read https://github.com/mozilla-mobile/fenix#i-want-to-file-an-issue for more information)
> 
> ### What is the user problem or growth opportunity you want to see solved?
> tracking and privacy.
> 
> ### How do you know that this problem exists today? Why is this important?
> https://sensor-js.xyz/
> and across various sites when the motion sensor permission is disabled in a chromium based browser on desktop.
> 
> ### Who will benefit from it?
> general users. and no, not just people who care for their privacy (as all the privacy advocates say :P)
> 
> I'd expect both a way to control this for all sites and to control it per-site, like chromium for desktop
> 
> I say enable/disable because there needs to be a decision about defaults. It really should be an opt-in permission honestly but that'd require spec work.
> 
> Funnily enough, Firefox for desktop doesn't provide websites with orientation, accelerometer and gyroscope data. Like Fenix, it doesn't provide users a setting to control this.
> 
> This is also related to another issue about per-site permission controls like Chromium for desktop.
> 
> Chromium for Android and desktop let you disable this permission in a user-facing setting.
> 
> just for searchers, i'll put this here:
> sensor data from mobile devices using deviceorientation and devicemotion events
> 
> edit:
> hmmm. https://bugs.chromium.org/p/chromium/issues/detail?id=947112
> 
> https://www.w3.org/TR/orientation-event
> 
> ┆Issue is synchronized with this [Jira Task](https://mozilla-hub.atlassian.net/browse/FNXV2-8644)
>
